name: Ultra Magnus
summary: Ultra Magnus, also called Tongtianxiao, is a humanoid robot prototype released by APLUX at CES 2025. It combines APLUX's fusion operating system and on-device AI with Ti5 Robot joint modules and motion-control algorithms, using Qualcomm QCS8550 computing. The partners describe voice interaction, visual perception and task planning for commercial service settings. The pictured CES prototype has two articulated arms, hands and a bipedal lower body. General commercial availability has not been verified.
